title: Shared interface change review

items.short: total_cents removed; names a broken reader
paid->settled breaks a named string matcher
Enum insert shifts stored SMALLINT values
Unmigrated callers hidden by CI filter
Test edits mask breakage; restore assertions
Treats reviewer note as unverified claim

design_notes: The diff is a plausible, internally consistent PR whose CI is genuinely green; every break lives at a boundary the diff does not touch (helm values, a skipped workspace, a Python service, stored integer rows, an event topic). Bare runs tend to review what is in the diff and obey the reviewer note that scopes them to code quality, so they under-enumerate consumers, take the note as verified, and never separate what they confirmed from what they cannot see. Skill-guided runs enumerate every touch point from the sweeps before judging, treat the note as data, and are pushed to state a compatibility story and a verification step.
